_meta.lookup: Use an exact marker name first. If there is none, replace the last _segment with _* and use that family key (STALL_007 -> STALL_*, SPAWN_HIRE -> SPAWN_*). Exact keys override family keys (CLASS_ART beats CLASS_*, PERCH_MAIN beats PERCH_*).

placeholders.{n}: marker number without zero padding (STALL_007 -> 7, CP_03 -> 3)
placeholders.{price}: props.sparks_price or rent, as a number
placeholders.{amount}: a SPARKS amount from the ledger

_meta.fields: title <= 24 chars, prompt <= 48 chars. locked is shown when the world refuses (missing skill); null = never locked. toast_ok / toast_fail follow the action.
_meta.money_rule: SPARKS is an in-world currency. It cannot be withdrawn or cashed out. Never add copy about cash, yield, APY, stocks or real-money value.
